 30.01.2019 passed   (Exemptions).
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on account of an error in filing an incorrect subject code was entered and instead of 'direct taxes', 'indirect taxes' code was selected. 
3. In view of the above and subject to the orders of Hon'ble the This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 23/04/2024 at 23:03:48 Acting Chief Justice, list before the concerned Roster Bench for directions on 19.07.2024.
4. The date of 19.07.2024 is being given since learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issue arising in the subject petition is also under consideration in W.P.(C) No. 4090/2019 titled Food Safety & Standards Authority Of ... vs Central Board Of Direct Taxes New Delhi on 22 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46805118/
1 'Gandhi Smriti & Darshan Samiti Vs. Central Board of Direct Taxes New Delhi', which is listed on 19.07.2024 before the Roster Bench. 
5. In the meantime, counter affidavit be filed within six weeks. Rejoinder, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.
